articles.fullText:
Chinese and German auto companies on Friday explored ways to boost cooperation amid profound global transformation and fierce industry competition.
The 10th German-Chinese Automotive Congress was held in Wolfsburg, Germany, on Friday, attended by some 600 representatives from China and Germany.
The automotive industry, including its suppliers and technology sectors, is undergoing one of the biggest and most rapid transformation processes in its history, according to Olaf Lies, minister-president of Lower Saxony state.
A wide range of factors are driving this transformation, including electrification, vehicle digitalization, artificial intelligence in manufacturing and in vehicles themselves, and autonomous driving, Lies said, adding that the congress sends a strong signal that cooperation between Germany and China should be deepened.
In the auto industry's current climate, it is very important that German and Chinese companies maintain dialogue and establish reliable and solid partnerships, said Thomas Schmall, CEO of Volkswagen Group Technology.
Meanwhile, Liu Minqiang, director-general of the Investment Promotion Agency of the Chinese Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), said competition is not detrimental to the automotive industry as transformation accelerates.
Rather, it helps upgrade the industry and plays a positive role in providing customers with better products and services, Liu added, urging companies to focus on improving their technologies, products and services.
Lin Dong, China's consul general in Hamburg, added that cooperation between Chinese and German auto companies has now gone beyond the conventional domain of complete vehicle production, expanding to areas including batteries, intelligent connection and technological innovations.
The Automotive Congress was held in the wake of the International Suppliers Fair, which kicked off in Wolfsburg on Tuesday. A total of 45 Chinese automotive suppliers were present at the fair.
Hunan pitches '5C' advantages
The economic and trade cooperation and exchange conference between China's Hunan Province and Germany, which also took place on Friday, coincided with the German-Chinese Automotive Congress.
Representatives of the German automotive industry have responded positively to delegates from central China's Hunan Province.
On the sidelines of the meeting, Gundula Henkel, a board member of the German-Chinese Association Saxony-Anhalt, leaned in with a candid smile, holding a notebook filled with scribbled notes.
As the presentations unfolded, Henkel found her view shifting fast and was deeply impressed by China's development momentum. People can see "how cleverly (China's) local strengths are paired with the right industries," she remarked. "It's a real eye-opener."
Liu Suyue, deputy director of the Hunan Provincial Department of Commerce, summarized Hunan's advantages as a favorable destination for German investment as "5C": cost, consumer base, a whole supply-chain cluster, a talent base of colleges and a convenient environment.
"We are ready to work with you, and I believe our sincerity can bridge the distance from the Xiang River to the Rhine," Liu said.
Germany is home to several well-known companies from Hunan Province, including the Sany Group.
A Chinese multinational heavy equipment manufacturer, Sany Group acquired Putzmeister, one of the world's leading construction equipment companies, in 2012.
Michael Bose, chairman of the board at automotive BerlinBrandenburg e.V., also attended the meeting.
"I am pleased that we have the opportunity today to engage with Hunan-and specifically with its representatives, as well as potentially later with Sany Group to discuss vehicles and automotive technologies," he said.
As the chairman of a German association representing companies from the special-purpose vehicle manufacturing sector, Bose is well aware that the German companies "currently have a very strong interest in, and are actively seeking contacts within, the electric vehicle industry, particularly regarding heavy trucks and heavy machinery in relation to China."
As a major manufacturing province in China, Hunan boasts a solid foundation in the automotive industry. These industrial capabilities not only provide enterprises with supporting supply chains and opportunities for market expansion, but also create ample room for China-Germany cooperation on new technologies and products, Liu Minqiang, the MOFCOM official, said in a speech at the meeting.
"By aligning Hunan's promotion meeting with the Sino-German Automotive Congress today, our objective is to deepen the German community's understanding of Hunan," Liu Minqiang said.
Uwe Fritsch, member relations specialist at automotiveland.nrw, an automotive industry cluster in the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, also highlighted the importance of closer exchanges between China and Germany.
"As Lower Saxony's Minister-President Olaf Lies has also pointed out, what we need is greater cooperation – and in both directions," Fritsch said. "This means not only closer economic collaboration between German and Chinese companies but also, equally importantly in the current climate, greater mutual understanding and dialogue."

articles.title: Yerevan Pathway sets course for biodiversity action
articles.titleCn: 埃里温路径为生物多样性行动指明方向
articles.summary: Yerevan Pathway sets course for biodiversity action
articles.summaryCn: COP17在埃里温闭幕，各方就“埃里温路径”等主要决定达成一致，但资金缺口与履约差距仍是实现2030年生物多样性目标的关键挑战。

paragraphs.en: The 17th meeting of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17) concluded in Yerevan, Armenia, on Saturday after negotiators secured agreement on the conference's main decisions, including the Yerevan Pathway aimed at {{0}} global biodiversity action. This encouraging outcome came at a {{1}} time for global biodiversity protection. Halfway between the adoption of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF) and its 2030 deadline, countries face a widening gap between their {{2}} to protect nature and the action to fulfill them. Whether the Yerevan Pathway can help close that gap will depend on financing, national policies and {{3}} international cooperation. Members of the secretariat during the closing session of the COP17 in Yerevan, Armenia, October 31, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 《生物多样性公约》缔约方大会第十七次会议（COP17）于周六在亚美尼亚埃里温闭幕，谈判代表就大会主要决定达成一致，其中包括旨在加速全球生物多样性行动的“埃里温路径”。这一令人鼓舞的成果出现在全球生物多样性保护的关键时刻。在《昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》（GBF）通过与其2030年截止日期之间的一半路程上，各国在保护自然的承诺与履行承诺的行动之间的差距正在扩大。“埃里温路径”能否帮助弥合这一差距，将取决于融资、国家政策和持续的国际合作。2026年10月31日，在亚美尼亚埃里温举行的COP17闭幕会议上，秘书处成员。

paragraphs.en:
A pathway to accelerate action
The conference's main task was to conduct the first global review of {{4}} progress in implementing the GBF, which sets out 23 targets for 2030. The {{5}} presented governments with a clear warning: Without a rapid acceleration of {{6}}, the framework's 2030 targets and mission would not be achieved, putting its longer-term goals for 2050 at risk. The Yerevan Pathway is part of the response to that assessment. Rather than setting new targets, it focuses on how countries can step up efforts to meet those already agreed upon. Embedded in the global review decision, the pathway identifies several {{7}} for the period through 2030: accelerating implementation, {{8}} the coverage of national targets, strengthening financial and other support, engaging governments and societies more widely, and improving {{9}} and knowledge.
paragraphs.cn: 加速行动的路径

paragraphs.en:
Alongside the negotiations, nearly $2 billion in new biodiversity funding was announced, according to the Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD). This included $560 million under the ninth {{10}} of the Global Environment Facility and its Global Biodiversity Framework Fund, $500 million through the Species Recovery Alliance and more than $330 million through the Value Nature Fund. Finance divide tests delivery
Finance remains one of the main {{11}} to implementation, both in terms of how much funding is available and how the responsibility for providing it is shared. The global report found that developed countries had failed to meet their commitment to provide at least $20 billion annually in biodiversity finance to developing countries by 2025. This {{12}} was a major point of {{13}} in negotiations over funding for the next stage of implementation.
paragraphs.cn: 大会的主要任务是对GBF实施方面的集体进展进行首次全球审查，该框架提出了2030年的23项目标。评估向各国政府发出了明确警告：如果不迅速加速实施，该框架的2030年目标和使命将无法实现，从而危及其2050年长期目标。“埃里温路径”是对该评估的回应的一部分。它没有设定新目标，而是侧重于各国如何加大努力以实现已经商定的目标。该路径嵌入全球审查决定之中，确定了到2030年期间的若干优先事项：加速实施、扩大国家目标的覆盖面、加强财政和其他支持、让政府和社会更广泛参与，以及改进监测和知识。

paragraphs.en:
Some developed countries called for broadening the contributor base, bringing into focus a longstanding dispute over the relationship between countries' financial capacity and their {{14}} under the CBD. The new funding announcements offered some encouragement, but the broader challenge of securing {{15}} support on the scale needed remains. For developing countries, efforts to strengthen {{16}}, {{17}} ecosystems and monitor progress continue to depend heavily on access to finance and technical assistance. China's role in advancing implementation
Turning commitments into {{18}} results was also a key theme in discussions of China's contribution, including its support for the global review, sharing experience in domestic conservation and financing for biodiversity projects in developing countries. The global review decision specifically thanked China for hosting the Kunming dialogue to support preparations for the review.

paragraphs.en: It also acknowledged financial support provided through the China Trust Fund via the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). During the conference, COP17 President Hambardzum Matevosyan said China had made important contributions to advancing the talks, from preparatory work to the formal negotiations. Astrid Schomaker, executive secretary of the secretariat of the CBD, said the progress reflected in China's seventh national report was encouraging and highlighted its ecological conservation red lines as an example of how biodiversity protection could be {{19}} into national planning and development. The 17th meeting of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17) concluded in Yerevan, Armenia, on Saturday after negotiators secured agreement on the conference's main decisions, including the Yerevan Pathway aimed at accelerating global biodiversity action.
This encouraging outcome came at a critical time for global biodiversity protection. Halfway between the adoption of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF) and its 2030 deadline, countries face a widening gap between their commitments to protect nature and the action to fulfill them. Whether the Yerevan Pathway can help close that gap will depend on financing, national policies and sustained international cooperation.
Members of the secretariat during the closing session of the COP17 in Yerevan, Armenia, October 31, 2026. 
A pathway to accelerate action
The conference's main task was to conduct the first global review of collective progress in implementing the GBF, which sets out 23 targets for 2030.
The assessment presented governments with a clear warning: Without a rapid acceleration of implementation, the framework's 2030 targets and mission would not be achieved, putting its longer-term goals for 2050 at risk.
The Yerevan Pathway is part of the response to that assessment. Rather than setting new targets, it focuses on how countries can step up efforts to meet those already agreed upon.
Embedded in the global review decision, the pathway identifies several priorities for the period through 2030: accelerating implementation, broadening the coverage of national targets, strengthening financial and other support, engaging governments and societies more widely, and improving monitoring and knowledge.
Alongside the negotiations, nearly $2 billion in new biodiversity funding was announced, according to the Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD). This included $560 million under the ninth replenishment of the Global Environment Facility and its Global Biodiversity Framework Fund, $500 million through the Species Recovery Alliance and more than $330 million through the Value Nature Fund.
Finance divide tests delivery
Finance remains one of the main obstacles to implementation, both in terms of how much funding is available and how the responsibility for providing it is shared.
The global report found that developed countries had failed to meet their commitment to provide at least $20 billion annually in biodiversity finance to developing countries by 2025. This shortfall was a major point of contention in negotiations over funding for the next stage of implementation.
Some developed countries called for broadening the contributor base, bringing into focus a longstanding dispute over the relationship between countries' financial capacity and their obligations under the CBD.
The new funding announcements offered some encouragement, but the broader challenge of securing predictable support on the scale needed remains. For developing countries, efforts to strengthen conservation, restore ecosystems and monitor progress continue to depend heavily on access to finance and technical assistance.
China's role in advancing implementation
Turning commitments into concrete results was also a key theme in discussions of China's contribution, including its support for the global review, sharing experience in domestic conservation and financing for biodiversity projects in developing countries.
The global review decision specifically thanked China for hosting the Kunming dialogue to support preparations for the review. It also acknowledged financial support provided through the China Trust Fund via the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).
During the conference, COP17 President Hambardzum Matevosyan said China had made important contributions to advancing the talks, from preparatory work to the formal negotiations.
Astrid Schomaker, executive secretary of the secretariat of the CBD, said the progress reflected in China's seventh national report was encouraging and highlighted its ecological conservation red lines as an example of how biodiversity protection could be incorporated into national planning and development.
Inger Andersen, executive director of the UNEP, recognized China's continued leadership through the establishment of the Kunming Biodiversity Fund following its COP15 presidency. She emphasized the importance of helping developing countries access the financing needed to implement the agreement.
The Yerevan conference preserved a common direction at a difficult moment for biodiversity protection. The next four years will determine whether governments can turn their commitments into measurable progress before the 2030 deadline.
As Schomaker put it: "Ultimately, the test is not what governments agreed in Yerevan, but what they change when they return home."

《生物多样性公约》缔约方大会第十七次会议（COP17）于周六在亚美尼亚埃里温闭幕，谈判代表就大会主要决定达成一致，其中包括旨在加速全球生物多样性行动的“埃里温路径”。这一令人鼓舞的成果出现在全球生物多样性保护的关键时刻。在《昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》（GBF）通过与其2030年截止日期之间的一半路程上，各国在保护自然的承诺与履行承诺的行动之间的差距正在扩大。“埃里温路径”能否帮助弥合这一差距，将取决于融资、国家政策和持续的国际合作。2026年10月31日，在亚美尼亚埃里温举行的COP17闭幕会议上，秘书处成员。

加速行动的路径

大会的主要任务是对GBF实施方面的集体进展进行首次全球审查，该框架提出了2030年的23项目标。评估向各国政府发出了明确警告：如果不迅速加速实施，该框架的2030年目标和使命将无法实现，从而危及其2050年长期目标。“埃里温路径”是对该评估的回应的一部分。它没有设定新目标，而是侧重于各国如何加大努力以实现已经商定的目标。该路径嵌入全球审查决定之中，确定了到2030年期间的若干优先事项：加速实施、扩大国家目标的覆盖面、加强财政和其他支持、让政府和社会更广泛参与，以及改进监测和知识。

据《生物多样性公约》（CBD）秘书处称，在谈判之外，还宣布了近20亿美元的新生物多样性资金。其中包括全球环境基金第九次增资及其全球生物多样性框架基金下的5.6亿美元、物种恢复联盟的5亿美元以及价值自然基金的超过3.3亿美元。资金鸿沟考验落实

资金仍然是实施的主要障碍之一，既体现在可用资金的多少上，也体现在提供资金的责任如何分担上。全球报告发现，发达国家未能兑现到2025年每年向发展中国家提供至少200亿美元生物多样性资金的承诺。这一缺口是下一阶段实施资金谈判中的主要争议点。

一些发达国家呼吁扩大出资方基础，这使各国财政能力与其在《生物多样性公约》下义务之间关系的长期争端再次成为焦点。新的资金宣布带来了一些鼓舞，但以所需规模获得可预测支持这一更广泛的挑战依然存在。对发展中国家而言，加强保护、恢复生态系统和监测进展的努力仍然严重依赖获得资金和技术援助。中国在推进实施中的作用

将承诺转化为具体成果也是讨论中国贡献时的关键主题，包括中国对全球审查的支持、分享国内保护经验以及为发展中国家的生物多样性项目提供资金。全球审查决定特别感谢中国主办昆明对话，为审查筹备工作提供支持。

决定还认可了通过联合国环境规划署（UNEP）中国信托基金提供的财政支持。会议期间，COP17主席哈姆巴尔德祖姆·马特沃相表示，中国从筹备工作到正式谈判都为推进会谈作出了重要贡献。《生物多样性公约》秘书处执行秘书阿斯特丽德·肖马克表示，中国第七次国家报告所反映的进展令人鼓舞，并强调其生态保护红线是生物多样性保护如何纳入国家规划和发展的一个范例。联合国环境规划署执行主任英格·安德森肯定了中国在担任COP15主席后通过设立昆明生物多样性基金所展现的持续领导力。她强调帮助发展中国家获得实施协议所需资金的重要性。

埃里温会议在生物多样性保护的艰难时刻保持了共同方向。未来四年将决定各国政府能否在2030年截止日期前将承诺转化为可衡量的进展。正如肖马克所说：“归根结底，考验的不是各国政府在埃里温同意了什么，而是他们回国后改变了什么。”

Following the phenomenal appearance of Black Myth: Wukong in 2024, the world recently witnessed the launch of another AAA-rated video game, Phantom Blade Zero, developed by a Chinese gaming company.
Less than an hour after its release on Thursday, the game, developed by S-Game, had surpassed 300,000 concurrent players on Steam, a digital distribution platform for PC games, with the player count climbing to more than 720,000 at its peak later that day.
In pre-release reviews, the PC version of Phantom Blade Zero earned an average score of 88 on the US review aggregator website Metacritic, surpassing the 81 scored by Black Myth: Wukong.
On Steam, 88 percent of more than 33,250 Chinese-language users gave positive reviews, while the figure among English-language users also reached 88 percent.
So far, the game has sold over 1 million copies, with preorder sales on the Steam and PS5 platforms estimated to surpass $43 million.
US video game critic Travis Northup rated it 9 out of 10, praising the action role-playing game as "amazing".
In his review on the US entertainment media platform Imagine Games Network, Northup wrote: "Phantom Blade Zero is an unbelievably smooth action game filled with memorable boss fights, compelling combat, and limitless swagger. … It is one of the best action games I've played in a long time."
He added that "its tale of betrayal and revenge mostly plays it extremely safe, and some unfortunate invisible barriers and technical hiccups can cause minor frustrations — but the overwhelming majority of my time with this stunning, incredibly well-tuned adventure was downright awesome".
The game begins with the story of a highly skilled martial artist named Soul, whose heart has been severely injured in a previous battle. On the verge of death, he is saved by a mysterious doctor. However, the treatment leaves him with only 66 days to live before his heart will ultimately fail. In the last days of his life, Soul embarks on a journey to find a new heart and to rediscover his true self and his original sense of chivalry in this dark phantom world full of lies and betrayals.
It "truly captures the essence of the martial arts world in (prestigious Chinese writer) Gu Long's novels, which is dark, chaotic, brutal, and romantic", said Feng Ji, the producer of Black Myth: Wukong, in his WeChat Moments after watching the livestreaming of an actual gameplay preview in July.
Before its official release, some 3 million people across all platforms added Phantom Blade Zero to their wish lists, making it one of the most anticipated Chinese action games of 2026. One of the reasons behind the game's popularity among foreign players lies in its rich kung fu elements.
Liang Qiwei, or Soulframe Liang, founder of S-Game and the game's producer, said, "At its core, it's a story rich with traditional Chinese elements". Liang, 45, made his first game at Tsinghua University 21 years ago.
In actual gameplay, what particularly impresses global players is the smooth, refreshing combat design in a style concept called "kungfupunk".
"Kungfupunk" blends traditional elements of Chinese wuxia (a fiction genre centered on martial arts adventures in ancient China), an atmosphere of ancient jianghu, or the realm of martial arts, steampunk-style machinery, occult body modification, and a dark, rebellious punk spirit to create a new form of expression, Liang told media in an earlier interview. In this world, swordsmen, martial arts sects and old Chinese architecture coexist with mechanical limbs, grim industrial ruins and modern rock music.
"We are creating an original global IP that belongs to us, strongly imprinted with the essence of Chinese wuxia culture," Liang said.
The game offers a total of 30 different weapons, all inspired by the vast collection of traditional Chinese weaponry.
"To understand how the weight and length of these weapons affect movement, we sometimes invite swordsmiths to forge them," Liang said in an article published online in April.
The martial arts moves are captured from more than 20 highly experienced kung fu actors, including Hong Kong movie star Donnie Yen.
Additionally, the production team explored locations like ancestral halls in Fujian province, ancient towns in Zhejiang province, and Beijing's old steel factories, scanning and creatively combining them into the unique "kungfupunk" art style.

China on Monday issued a guideline to boost financial support for building international science and technology centers in Beijing (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region), Shanghai (the Yangtze River Delta), and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA).
The guideline, released by the People's Bank of China (PBOC) along with ten other departments, aims to build a financial service system that better matches the core functions and international positioning of the three innovation hubs.
By 2030, the country aims to establish a sound full-chain financial service system for technological innovation, achieve a "notable increase" in the proportion of direct financing, and basically form a pattern of integrated financial services in the three regions, according to the guideline.
Among the specific measures, the guideline calls for improving foreign exchange business facilitation policies for qualified foreign limited partners (QFLP), a move that is expected to facilitate overseas institutions' equity investment in China.
It also vows to make cross-border fund management simpler for multinational tech companies and for Chinese firms funding their overseas R&D centers.
The document sets out differentiated priorities for each region. The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region will focus on original innovation and coordinated regional innovation, with stronger financial support for major science and technology infrastructure.
The Yangtze River Delta will leverage its industrial cluster advantages to build a technology finance ecosystem featuring multi-party participation and shared benefits.
The GBA will develop an open technology finance system, with an emphasis on deepening high-level financial interaction and regulatory alignment among Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao.
The guideline also stresses building risk prevention and control mechanisms to firmly guard against systemic financial risks.
Speaking at the Annual Conference of Financial Street Forum 2026 in Beijing on Monday, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng said that building the three international sci-tech innovation centers is a major strategy of the central authorities. Pan highlighted that the central bank will push for greater pilot efforts in the three regions in areas such as relending, the bond market's "sci-tech board" and cross-border investment and financing.
The country's 14th Five-Year Plan (2021-2025) called for supporting the initiative of making Beijing, Shanghai, and the GBA international centers for science and technology innovation, a goal that has guided progress over the past five years.
The expansion of the Beijing and Shanghai centers into the wider Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and the Yangtze River Delta, respectively, marks a shift from single-city breakthroughs toward coordinated regional development, a direction set out at the 2025 Central Economic Work Conference.

中国周一发布指导意见，加大对北京（京津冀地区）、上海（长三角地区）和粤港澳大湾区建设国际科技创新中心的金融支持力度。该指导意见由中国人民银行等十一个部门发布，旨在构建与三大创新枢纽核心功能和国际定位更加匹配的金融服务体系。根据该指导意见，到2030年，中国力争建立完善的科技创新全链条金融服务体系，实现直接融资占比“显著提升”，并在三大区域基本形成一体化金融服务格局。在具体措施中，指导意见提出完善合格境外有限合伙人（QFLP）外汇业务便利化政策，此举预计将便利境外机构对华股权投资。指导意见还承诺，为跨国科技企业以及资助其海外研发中心的中国企业简化跨境资金管理。文件为各地区设定了差异化重点。京津冀地区将聚焦原始创新和区域协同创新，加大对重大科技基础设施的金融支持。

长三角地区将发挥产业集群优势，构建多方参与、利益共享的科技金融生态体系。粤港澳大湾区将发展开放的科技金融体系，重点深化广东、香港和澳门之间的高水平金融互动和监管对接。指导意见还强调建立风险防控机制，坚决防范系统性金融风险。中国人民银行行长潘功胜周一在北京举行的2026金融街论坛年会上发表讲话时表示，建设三大国际科技创新中心是中央的重大战略。潘功胜强调，央行将推动三大地区在再贷款、债券市场“科技板”以及跨境投融资等领域加大试点力度。国家“十四五”规划（2021-2025年）提出支持北京、上海和粤港澳大湾区建设国际科技创新中心的倡议，这一目标指导了过去五年的进展。北京和上海中心分别扩展至更广泛的京津冀地区和长三角地区，标志着从单一城市突破转向区域协同发展，这是2025年中央经济工作会议确定的方向。
